key_idea: Sum of maxima = sum over v=1..9 of the number of substrings whose max is >= v, and substrings with all digits < v are counted by run lengths.
sketch: For each threshold v scan the string, accumulating run*(run+1)/2 for maximal runs of digits below v, and subtract from n(n+1)/2. The total sum is at most 9*2e10, so 64-bit. Divide by n(n+1)/2 and print as integer, proper fraction or mixed number in lowest terms (the three output formats are the main pitfall, including the all-zero case printing 0). O(10 n).
